nodes.label: Autopoietic Agent Coordination
nodes.rationale: Living emergent system where agents share context but keep autonomy; alignment without control, emergence over planning, conflict treated as signal — parallel experiments beat forced consensus.

nodes.label: Nine-Step Deterministic Startup Sequence
nodes.rationale: Ordered outer layer to inner layer: values before operations (SOUL before HEARTBEAT), environmental awareness before action (TOOLS before execution), validation last to prevent stale schema deployments.

nodes.label: Subagent Delegation with Model Tiers
nodes.rationale: Cost-efficient task distribution: cheap models for file I/O and synthesis, mid-tier for quality review, expensive models reserved for final approval — significant cost savings without quality loss.

nodes.label: Workfront-Based Priority Tracking
nodes.rationale: Named workfronts with status, ownership, deliverables give clear accountability and surface blockers early; visible in all HEARTBEAT.md files.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Safety Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Safety holds when boundaries are clearly articulated: autonomous tier for workspace files and drafts, approval tier for external comms, on-chain actions, identity changes, and financial actions.

nodes.label: Success Metrics + Next Actions
nodes.rationale: Metrics give agents a north star; prioritized next actions at three timeframes (session/week/month) prevent decision paralysis.

nodes.label: Federation Through Shared Data
nodes.rationale: Nodes stay aligned by sharing context via federation.yaml, skills/, knowledge commons, and GitHub Actions automation — no centralized control, each node keeps autonomy.

nodes.label: Daily Memory + Auto-Commit
nodes.rationale: Append-only daily memory plus 30-minute auto-commit gives zero-effort continuity; git history serves as audit trail.

nodes.label: Organizational OS as Living System
nodes.rationale: The template should enable living systems, not enforce rigid structure — customization placeholders, patterns to adapt to local context, federation mechanisms for knowledge flow.
